clips.subtitleText: Level 1: Confessed over a candlelit NYC dinner and got the warmest street hug 🕯️❤️
Level 2: Asked his crush on the beach at night and she said "I have been and I will be" 🌙✨
Level 3: Surprised his best friend with roses and a lightbox asking to be her boyfriend 🌹🥹
Level 4: Asked his best friend under the tree and she smiled "You already know, it's a yes" 🌳💘
Level 5: Admitted he loved his best friend and she pulled him in by his hoodie for a kiss 😭🔥
